content.title: THE PLAYERS Championship 2026 at TPC Sawgrass | St. Augustine & Ponte Vedra, FL
content.text: THE PLAYERS Championship 2026 at TPC Sawgrass | St. Augustine & Ponte Vedra, FL Home Events Annual Events THE PLAYERS Championship THE PLAYERS Championship March 10–15, 2026 Time to enjoy one of the most prestigious events in sports with some of the biggest names in golf and music! Kick off Spring with six days of excitement and fun as golf’s best players hit the links and compete on this legendary course. Along with world-renowned golfers, this year’s musical celebration includes a performance by three-time Grammy Award-winner, Ludacris. It doesn’t get more exciting than that! THE PLAYERS Championship The 2026 field features a 120-player line-up headlined by top PGA talent. That includes defending champion Rory McIlroy, who won the hearts of all golf aficionados at last year’s PLAYERS. He’ll be joined by two-time PLAYERS champ and always a top threat, Scottie Scheffler, as well as Keegan Bradley and Brooks Koepka. The 2026 roster promises to be one of the most competitive and thrilling in PLAYERS history. TPC Sawgrass Stadium Course The course is as legendary as the athletes who play it. Created by Pete Dye, The Stadium Course has served as the home of THE PLAYERS for over 40 years. Best known for its iconic Island Green on the 17th hole, one of the most notoriously challenging and universally recognized holes in golf, the Stadium course is a fan favorite because it prioritizes the spectator experience with superb visibility, easy navigation and comfortable seating with covered bleachers overlooking the 10, 12, 13 and 16 holes. Not to mention a stunning view of the Mediterranean-style clubhouse. PLAYERS 2026 Elevate your PLAYERS experience at the Intracoastal Club, offering open-air comfort, abundant televisions so you don’t miss any action, high-top seating and upscale food and beverage options. The Intracoastal Club is situated between holes 12 and 13. New this year, members of THE PLAYERS Club, the tournament’s premier hospitality offering, can enjoy access to Iron & Wedge, a luxury steakhouse dining venue, where they can indulge in a refined culinary experience with views of the 18th green. Military Appreciation Day and Concert Military Appreciation Day is set for Tuesday, March 10, featuring a 4:30 p.m. concert by hip hop icon and three-time Grammy Award-winner, Ludacris, on the Island Green 17th hole. Once again, a comprehensive lineup of complimentary and discounted ticket options for service members, veterans and their families. The performance will be family-friendly and suitable for audiences of all ages. Two children, ages 15 and under, may attend free with each ticketed adult. Admission is included with any Tuesday ticket, available at THEPLAYERS.com/tickets; parking requires a separate advance purchase here. Tickets are available while supplies last.New for 2026, a dedicated food-and-beverage redemption point will be available within the Outpost, allowing military guests to conveniently use their $20 digital vouchers while enjoying the venue. Tickets and Parking All admission and parking tickets must be purchased in advance. Tuesday and Wednesday (March 10 and 11): admission starts at $44 Thursday—Sunday (March 12—15): Admission starts at $109Youth admission: Each adult ticket allows free entry for two youths (15 and under)Military tickets: Free admission is available for active duty, retired and reserve members plus one dependent on Tuesday, Wednesday and one competitive day.Parking passes are digital and must be purchased separately: $24 for Tuesday and Wednesday, $54 for all other days.
